metadata.description: Creates the Template Spec 'Abstract Security for Microsoft Sentinel' with its guided portal form. Open it afterwards at Template specs > the spec > Deploy.

{"$schema":"https://schema.management.azure.com/schemas/2019-04-01/deploymentTemplate.json#","contentVersion":"1.0.0.0","metadata":{"_generator":{"name":"bicep","version":"0.47.16.16243","templateHash":"10762247756998572340"}},"parameters":{"location":{"type":"string","defaultValue":"[resourceGroup().location]","metadata":{"description":"Azure region of a new workspace, and of the Data Collection Endpoint and Rule. Change it only when the resource group's region is not where the data should live; every Abstract resource must sit in the workspace's region, and moving it later means a new workspace. Find it: Azure portal > Resource groups > your group > Overview > Location. Default: the resource group's region. Example: eastus."}},"createWorkspace":{"type":"bool","defaultValue":true,"metadata":{"description":"true creates a Log Analytics workspace and switches Microsoft Sentinel on. Set false to use a workspace that already runs Sentinel in this resource group; nothing about that workspace (SKU, retention, daily cap, network) is changed. Find it: Azure portal > Microsoft Sentinel lists every workspace that runs Sentinel, with its resource group. Default: true. Example: false. A new workspace is a new billable resource; pointing Abstract at a second workspace splits your data."}},"workspaceName":{"type":"string","defaultValue":"","metadata":{"description":"Name of the workspace. New workspace: leave empty to generate abstract-sentinel-<hash>, or give a name of 4 to 63 letters, digits and hyphens. Existing workspace: its exact name, which must be in this resource group, or the deployment fails. Find it: Azure portal > Log Analytics workspaces > Name. Default: empty. Example: sentinel-prod."}},"workspaceRetentionDays":{"type":"int","defaultValue":90,"minValue":7,"maxValue":730,"metadata":{"description":"Interactive retention of a new workspace, 7 to 730 days. Used only when createWorkspace is true; an existing workspace is never changed. Raise it when policy needs searchable data longer. Find the current value: Azure portal > Log Analytics workspaces > the workspace > Usage and estimated costs > Data retention. Default: 90. Example: 180. Microsoft Sentinel includes 90 days; each day above that is billed per GB retained."}},"existingWorkspaceLocation":{"type":"string","defaultValue":"","metadata":{"description":"Region of the existing workspace, when it differs from location. The Data Collection Endpoint and Rule must be in the workspace's region; a mismatch fails the deployment. Leave empty for a new workspace, or when the workspace is in location. Find it: Azure portal > Log Analytics workspaces > the workspace > Overview > Location. Default: empty. Example: eastus2."}},"tags":{"type":"object","defaultValue":{},"metadata":{"description":"Tags on every resource the template creates that supports tags. Set them when your policy requires tags such as owner or cost centre; Azure Policy can deny an untagged deployment. Find what is required: Azure portal > Policy > Assignments on this subscription. Default: none. Example: {"owner": "secops"}."}},"principalId":{"type":"string","defaultValue":"","metadata":{"description":"Object ID of the service principal Abstract signs in as. It gets Monitoring Metrics Publisher on the Data Collection Rule only, which is all the Logs Ingestion API needs. Find it: Microsoft Entra ID > Enterprise applications > the Abstract app > Overview > Object ID. Not the Application (client) ID, which fails with PrincipalNotFound or grants nothing. Default: empty, which skips the grant: Abstract then gets HTTP 403 until you grant the role yourself. Example: the object ID GUID shown on that page."}},"dataCollectionEndpointName":{"type":"string","defaultValue":"abstract-dce","metadata":{"description":"Name of the Data Collection Endpoint Abstract sends to. Change it when a resource of that name already exists in the resource group for something else: a same-named endpoint is updated in place. Find existing ones: Azure portal > Monitor > Data Collection Endpoints. Default: abstract-dce. Example: abstract-dce-prod. Its URL is the output dataCollectionEndpointUrl."}},"dataCollectionRuleName":{"type":"string","defaultValue":"abstract-dcr","metadata":{"description":"Name of the Data Collection Rule. Keep the name across redeploys: the rule then keeps its immutable ID and Abstract keeps sending. A new name creates a second rule with a new ID, which the Abstract destination must then be changed to, and a same-named rule made for something else is replaced. Find existing ones: Azure portal > Monitor > Data Collection Rules. Default: abstract-dcr. Example: abstract-dcr-prod."}},"customTablePlan":{"type":"string","defaultValue":"Keep","allowedValues":["Keep","Analytics","Basic","Auxiliary"],"metadata":{"description":"Table plan of AbstractEventLogs_CL. Keep leaves an existing table's plan alone and creates a new table as Analytics, so a redeploy never changes cost by accident. Analytics runs analytics rules and this content; Basic is cheaper with limited queries; Auxiliary is the data lake tier, cheapest, with no analytics rules or alerts on it. A plan set here applies to the whole table. Find the current plan: Log Analytics workspaces > the workspace > Tables > AbstractEventLogs_CL > Plan. Default: Keep. Example: Analytics."}},"customTableRetentionDays":{"type":"int","defaultValue":0,"minValue":0,"maxValue":4383,"metadata":{"description":"Total retention of AbstractEventLogs_CL in days, 0 to 4383. 0 sends no retention: an existing table keeps its own, a new one takes the workspace's. Shortening it deletes data older than the new value; lengthening it bills each extra GB-day. Find the current value: Log Analytics workspaces > the workspace > Tables > AbstractEventLogs_CL > Total retention. Default: 0. Example: 365."}},"enableDcrErrorLogs":{"type":"bool","defaultValue":true,"metadata":{"description":"Send the Data Collection Rule's ingestion errors (rejected requests, malformed rows, transformation and limit errors) to the DCRLogErrors table. Leave it on: the ingestion API answers 204 before it validates, so without it data Azure drops is invisible to you and to Abstract. Turn it off only if another diagnostic setting already collects these errors. Where it lands: Logs > DCRLogErrors. Default: true. Example: true. Cost: only the error rows."}},"enableAsim":{"type":"bool","defaultValue":false,"metadata":{"description":"Also write each event into the Microsoft ASim table for its schema (ASimAuthenticationEventLogs, ASimNetworkSessionLogs and the others in asimSchemas), mapped from the Abstract Common Schema. Turn it on so Microsoft's ASIM analytics rules, hunting queries and workbooks see Abstract data. Expect new alerts, and duplicates where a Microsoft connector already collects the same vendor. Without excludeAsimFromAbstractTable each mapped event is stored and billed twice. Needs Microsoft Sentinel on the workspace. Find the tables: Logs > Tables > ASim*. Default: false. Example: true."}},"asimSchemas":{"type":"array","defaultValue":["*"],"metadata":{"description":"ASIM schemas to write when enableAsim is on: ['*'] for all eight (AuditEvent, Authentication, Dns, FileEvent, NetworkSession, ProcessEvent, RegistryEvent, WebSession), or a list of names. Narrow it to bring ASIM in one schema at a time. Each schema is one dataflow of the 20 a rule allows. Default: ['*']. Example: ['Authentication', 'NetworkSession']."}},"excludeAsimFromAbstractTable":{"type":"bool","defaultValue":false,"metadata":{"description":"Store once. With enableAsim on, an event an ASIM dataflow takes is not also written to AbstractEventLogs_CL, so it is stored and billed once, in its ASim table. Turn it on once your content reads the ASim tables; this solution's rules and parser already do. Content of your own that reads only AbstractEventLogs_CL stops seeing those events. Default: false. Example: true."}},"lakeTableName":{"type":"string","defaultValue":"","metadata":{"description":"Name of a second custom table on the Auxiliary (data lake) plan, for events nothing in Sentinel needs to alert on. Set it with lakeCategories to cut cost: lake rows cost about 0.15 USD per GB at eastus list price against about 4.30 in the Analytics tier, but analytics rules, ASIM parsers and this content do not run on them, and the /query API returns no rows for them (use the /search API or a KQL job). Must end in _CL. Default: empty, lake route off. Example: AbstractLake_CL."}},"lakeCategories":{"type":"array","defaultValue":[],"metadata":{"description":"Abstract Common Schema event categories sent to the lake table instead of AbstractEventLogs_CL. An event matches when its event.category contains one of them. Events an ASIM dataflow takes never go to the lake. Find the categories in your data: in Abstract, the event.category field of the events you route. Default: empty, lake route off. Example: ['network', 'dns']."}},"lakeRetentionDays":{"type":"int","defaultValue":365,"minValue":30,"maxValue":4383,"metadata":{"description":"Total retention of the lake table in days, 30 to 4383. Example: 730."}},"nativeVendors":{"type":"array","defaultValue":[],"metadata":{"description":"Vendors and Microsoft tables the rule also writes to, one dataflow each of the 20 a rule allows, so Microsoft's own Content hub content works unchanged on Abstract-delivered data. Supported: okta (OktaV2_CL, created if missing), crowdstrike-hosts (CrowdStrikeHostsV2_CL, created if missing), csl-cef (CEF lines into CommonSecurityLog), csl-acs (Cisco ASA, Fortinet FortiGate and F5 ASM into CommonSecurityLog), syslog (Linux, Nutanix and Infoblox lines into Syslog), aws-cloudtrail (AWSCloudTrail), and the ASIM schemas asim-alert (Abstract findings into ASimAlertEventLogs), asim-dhcp (ASimDhcpEventLogs) and asim-user-management (ASimUserManagementActivityLogs). Use a vendor entry instead of, not as well as, Microsoft's own connector for that vendor, or every event arrives twice. When two entries select the same event it goes to one table only, the first in this order: asim-alert, okta, crowdstrike-hosts, aws-cloudtrail, csl-cef, csl-acs, syslog, asim-dhcp, asim-user-management. So Infoblox DHCP lines stay in Syslog, and CloudTrail and Okta user changes stay in AWSCloudTrail and OktaV2_CL. An unsupported name stops the deployment before any change. Default: none. Example: ['okta', 'csl-cef']."}},"oktaDomain":{"type":"string","defaultValue":"","metadata":{"description":"Your Okta org domain, written to the DomainName column of OktaV2_CL as Microsoft's own Okta connector does. Used only with okta in nativeVendors. Microsoft's Okta content does not filter on it, so empty works, but the column is then empty. Find it: the address you sign in to Okta with, without https://. Default: empty. Example: example.okta.com."}},"excludeNativeVendorsFromAsim":{"type":"bool","defaultValue":true,"metadata":{"description":"Stores each vendor event in one place. With a vendor in nativeVendors, an event that vendor's table takes is not also written to the ASim tables or the lake, and, with excludeAsimFromAbstractTable on, not to AbstractEventLogs_CL either. Without it the same Okta event lands in both ASimAuditEventLogs and OktaV2_CL and is billed twice. Turn it off only if you need that vendor in Microsoft's ASIM content as well as in the vendor's own solution. With it on, this solution's two analytics rules, the connector tile and ASim_AbstractEvent read that vendor's table, so they still see its events, but Microsoft's own ASIM rules and parsers do not. Find what a vendor lane takes: Logs, then query the vendor table, for example OktaV2_CL. Default: true. Example: true."}},"deployDataConnectors":{"type":"bool","defaultValue":true,"metadata":{"description":"Install the data connector tile Abstract Security (Security Data Pipeline). Default: true. Example: true. No ingestion cost."}},"deployParsers":{"type":"bool","defaultValue":true,"metadata":{"description":"Install the workspace function ASim_AbstractEvent, which reads every Abstract event wherever the routes stored it and gives it ASIM column names. Example: true."}},"deployAnalyticsRules":{"type":"bool","defaultValue":true,"metadata":{"description":"Install the analytics rules High or Critical event and Repeated auth failures followed by success. An enabled rule runs every hour and can create incidents."}},"deployHuntingQueries":{"type":"bool","defaultValue":true,"metadata":{"description":"Install the hunting queries Rare or newly-seen product activity, High cumulative-risk identities and Daily value & reduction summary. Find the output: the storage account in this resource group, container sentinel-discovery. Default: false. Example: false."}},"deployPlaybooks":{"type":"bool","defaultValue":true,"metadata":{"description":"Install the playbooks Abstract-Enrich-Incident, Abstract-Verdict and Abstract-Tune-At-Source (Logic Apps with a Sentinel API connection). // ASim_AbstractEvent: every Abstract event, wherever this solution's routes stored it
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// One row per stored Abstract event, with ASIM-aligned column names, read from:
//   - AbstractEventLogs_CL: every event no other route took (all events when the
//     store-once option is off);
//   - the ASim tables, only with the store-once option on (otherwise the same
//     events are already in AbstractEventLogs_CL): Abstract rows only, recognised
//     by AdditionalFields.AbstractEventId;
//   - each lane table whose events are stored only there (the store-once option
//     and excludeNativeVendorsFromAsim both on): OktaV2_CL (okta), CommonSecurityLog
//     and Syslog rows with CollectorHostName 'Abstract' (csl-cef, csl-acs, syslog),
//     AWSCloudTrail (aws-cloudtrail), CrowdStrikeHostsV2_CL (crowdstrike-hosts), and
//     Abstract rows in ASimAlertEventLogs, ASimDhcpEventLogs and
//     ASimUserManagementActivityLogs. OktaV2_CL, AWSCloudTrail and
//     CrowdStrikeHostsV2_CL carry no Abstract marker, so rows Microsoft's own
//     connector writes into them are read too.
// The lake table (Auxiliary plan) is not read: the query API does not serve it.
// The deployment fills in __ABSTRACT_READ_ASIM__ and __ABSTRACT_NATIVE_VENDORS__
// from the routes it built, so the parser never counts one event twice.
// AbstractSourceTable names the table each row came from. AbstractEvent is one bag per row in every case, so tiles that
// read AbstractEvent.product, .severity or .aggregation_count work on all of them. risk_score, identity and tags are carried
// only on rows in AbstractEventLogs_CL, so a tile that measures them counts those rows.
// =============================================================================
let ASim_AbstractEvent = (disabled: bool = false) {
    let readAsim = __ABSTRACT_READ_ASIM__;
    let nativeVendors = dynamic(__ABSTRACT_NATIVE_VENDORS__);
    let abstractRows = AbstractEventLogs_CL
        | extend AbstractEvent = iff(isnotnull(column_ifexists('AbstractEvent', dynamic(null))), column_ifexists('AbstractEvent', dynamic(null)), pack_all()), Message = tostring(column_ifexists('Message', ''))
        | extend e = AbstractEvent
        | extend
            EventVendor      = tostring(e.vendor),
            EventProduct     = tostring(e.product),
            EventType        = coalesce(tostring(e.type), tostring(e.acs_type)),
            EventResult      = tostring(e.action),
            EventSeverity    = tostring(e.severity),
            EventMessage     = coalesce(tostring(e.message), Message),
            EventCount       = toreal(e.aggregation_count),
            EventRiskScore   = toreal(e.risk_score),
            SrcIpAddr        = coalesce(tostring(e.source_ipv4), tostring(e.source_ipv6), tostring(e.source_address)),
            DstIpAddr        = coalesce(tostring(e.dest_ipv4), tostring(e.dest_ipv6), tostring(e.dest_address)),
            SrcPortNumber    = toint(e.source_port),
            DstPortNumber    = toint(e.dest_port),
            DvcIpAddr        = coalesce(tostring(e.host_ipv4), tostring(e.host_ipv6), tostring(e.host_address)),
            DvcHostname      = tostring(e.host_name),
            ActorUsername    = coalesce(tostring(e.user_name), tostring(e.user_id)),
            TargetUsername   = coalesce(tostring(e.user.target.name), tostring(e['user.target.name'])),
            UserAgent        = tostring(e.user_agent),
            AbstractEventId  = coalesce(tostring(e.id), tostring(e.acs_id)),
            AbstractDataset  = tostring(e.data_stream.dataset),
            AbstractIdentity = tostring(e.identity),
            AbstractMatchedRules = e.matched_rules,
            AbstractTags     = e.tags,
            AbstractTimestamp = coalesce(todatetime(e['@timestamp']), todatetime(e.timestamp)),
            AbstractSourceTable = 'AbstractEventLogs_CL';
    let asimRows = union isfuzzy=true ASimAuditEventLogs, ASimAuthenticationEventLogs, ASimDnsActivityLogs,
            ASimFileEventLogs, ASimNetworkSessionLogs, ASimProcessEventLogs, ASimRegistryEventLogs, ASimWebSessionLogs,
            (ASimAlertEventLogs | where set_has_element(nativeVendors, 'asim-alert')),
            (ASimDhcpEventLogs | where set_has_element(nativeVendors, 'asim-dhcp')),
            (ASimUserManagementActivityLogs | where set_has_element(nativeVendors, 'asim-user-management')),
            (datatable(TimeGenerated: datetime)[])
        | extend _row = pack_all(), _af = column_ifexists('AdditionalFields', dynamic(null))
        | where readAsim and isnotnull(_af.AbstractEventId)
        | extend
            EventVendor      = tostring(column_ifexists('EventVendor', '')),
            EventProduct     = tostring(column_ifexists('EventProduct', '')),
            EventType        = tostring(column_ifexists('EventType', '')),
            EventResult      = tostring(column_ifexists('EventResult', '')),
            EventSeverity    = tostring(column_ifexists('EventSeverity', '')),
            EventMessage     = tostring(column_ifexists('EventMessage', '')),
            EventCount       = toreal(column_ifexists('EventCount', int(null))),
            EventRiskScore   = real(null),
            SrcIpAddr        = tostring(column_ifexists('SrcIpAddr', '')),
            DstIpAddr        = tostring(column_ifexists('DstIpAddr', '')),
            SrcPortNumber    = toint(column_ifexists('SrcPortNumber', int(null))),
            DstPortNumber    = toint(column_ifexists('DstPortNumber', int(null))),
            DvcIpAddr        = tostring(column_ifexists('DvcIpAddr', '')),
            DvcHostname      = tostring(column_ifexists('DvcHostname', '')),
            ActorUsername    = coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists('ActorUsername', '')), tostring(column_ifexists('TargetUsername', '')), tostring(column_ifexists('Username', ''))),
            TargetUsername   = tostring(column_ifexists('TargetUsername', '')),
            UserAgent        = tostring(column_ifexists('HttpUserAgent', '')),
            AbstractEventId  = tostring(_af.AbstractEventId),
            AbstractDataset  = tostring(_af.AbstractDataset),
            AbstractIdentity = '',
            AbstractMatchedRules = _af.AbstractMatchedRules,
            AbstractTags     = dynamic(null),
            AbstractTimestamp = TimeGenerated,
            AbstractSourceTable = tostring(column_ifexists('Type', ''))
        | extend AbstractEvent = bag_merge(pack('vendor', EventVendor, 'product', EventProduct, 'severity', tolower(EventSeverity),
            'aggregation_count', EventCount, 'matched_rules', AbstractMatchedRules), _row);
    let oktaRows = union isfuzzy=true (OktaV2_CL | where set_has_element(nativeVendors, 'okta')), (datatable(TimeGenerated: datetime)[] | where false)
        | extend _row = pack_all()
        | extend
            EventVendor      = 'Okta',
            EventProduct     = 'Okta',
            EventType        = tostring(column_ifexists('EventOriginalType', '')),
            EventResult      = tostring(column_ifexists('EventResult', '')),
            EventSeverity    = tostring(column_ifexists('EventSeverity', '')),
            EventMessage     = tostring(column_ifexists('EventMessage', '')),
            EventCount       = real(1),
            EventRiskScore   = real(null),
            SrcIpAddr        = tostring(column_ifexists('SrcIpAddr', '')),
            DstIpAddr        = '',
            SrcPortNumber    = int(null),
            DstPortNumber    = int(null),
            DvcIpAddr        = '',
            DvcHostname      = '',
            ActorUsername    = tostring(column_ifexists('ActorUsername', '')),
            TargetUsername   = '',
            UserAgent        = tostring(column_ifexists('HttpUserAgent', '')),
            AbstractEventId  = '',
            AbstractDataset  = '',
            AbstractIdentity = '',
            AbstractMatchedRules = dynamic(null),
            AbstractTags     = dynamic(null),
            AbstractTimestamp = TimeGenerated,
            AbstractSourceTable = 'OktaV2_CL'
        | extend AbstractEvent = bag_merge(pack('vendor', EventVendor, 'product', EventProduct, 'severity', tolower(EventSeverity),
            'aggregation_count', EventCount), _row);
    // The lanes into Microsoft's own tables. Columns are read with column_ifexists so a missing table or column is empty.
    let laneRows = union isfuzzy=true
            (CommonSecurityLog | where (set_has_element(nativeVendors, 'csl-cef') or set_has_element(nativeVendors, 'csl-acs')) and CollectorHostName == 'Abstract'
                | extend _v = DeviceVendor, _p = DeviceProduct, _t = Activity, _r = DeviceAction, _s = LogSeverity, _m = Message,
                    _src = SourceIP, _dst = DestinationIP, _sp = SourcePort, _dp = DestinationPort, _dvc = DeviceName, _u = SourceUserName, _src_t = 'CommonSecurityLog'),
            (Syslog | where set_has_element(nativeVendors, 'syslog') and CollectorHostName == 'Abstract'
                | extend _v = '', _p = ProcessName, _t = Facility, _r = '', _s = SeverityLevel, _m = SyslogMessage,
                    _src = HostIP, _dst = '', _sp = int(null), _dp = int(null), _dvc = Computer, _u = '', _src_t = 'Syslog'),
            (AWSCloudTrail | where set_has_element(nativeVendors, 'aws-cloudtrail')
                | extend _v = 'AWS', _p = EventSource, _t = EventName, _r = iff(isempty(ErrorCode), 'Success', 'Failure'), _s = '', _m = EventName,
                    _src = SourceIpAddress, _dst = '', _sp = int(null), _dp = int(null), _dvc = '', _u = UserIdentityArn, _src_t = 'AWSCloudTrail'),
            (CrowdStrikeHostsV2_CL | where set_has_element(nativeVendors, 'crowdstrike-hosts')
                | extend _v = 'CrowdStrike', _p = 'Falcon', _t = 'host', _r = '', _s = '', _m = '',
                    _src = tostring(column_ifexists('LocalIp', '')), _dst = '', _sp = int(null), _dp = int(null), _dvc = tostring(column_ifexists('Hostname', '')), _u = '', _src_t = 'CrowdStrikeHostsV2_CL'),
            (datatable(TimeGenerated: datetime)[] | where false)
        | extend _row = pack_all()
        | extend
            EventVendor      = tostring(column_ifexists('_v', '')),
            EventProduct     = tostring(column_ifexists('_p', '')),
            EventType        = tostring(column_ifexists('_t', '')),
            EventResult      = tostring(column_ifexists('_r', '')),
            EventSeverity    = tostring(column_ifexists('_s', '')),
            EventMessage     = tostring(column_ifexists('_m', '')),
            EventCount       = real(1),
            EventRiskScore   = real(null),
            SrcIpAddr        = tostring(column_ifexists('_src', '')),
            DstIpAddr        = tostring(column_ifexists('_dst', '')),
            SrcPortNumber    = toint(column_ifexists('_sp', int(null))),
            DstPortNumber    = toint(column_ifexists('_dp', int(null))),
            DvcIpAddr        = '',
            DvcHostname      = tostring(column_ifexists('_dvc', '')),
            ActorUsername    = tostring(column_ifexists('_u', '')),
            TargetUsername   = '',
            UserAgent        = '',
            AbstractEventId  = '',
            AbstractDataset  = '',
            AbstractIdentity = '',
            AbstractMatchedRules = dynamic(null),
            AbstractTags     = dynamic(null),
            AbstractTimestamp = TimeGenerated,
            AbstractSourceTable = tostring(column_ifexists('_src_t', ''))
        | extend AbstractEvent = bag_merge(pack('vendor', EventVendor, 'product', EventProduct, 'severity', tolower(EventSeverity),
            'aggregation_count', EventCount), _row)
        | project-away _v, _p, _t, _r, _s, _m, _src, _dst, _sp, _dp, _dvc, _u, _src_t;
    union isfuzzy=true abstractRows, asimRows, oktaRows, laneRows
    | where not(disabled)
    | project-away _af, _row
    | project-reorder
        TimeGenerated, EventVendor, EventProduct, EventType, EventResult, EventSeverity,
        SrcIpAddr, DstIpAddr, SrcPortNumber, DstPortNumber, ActorUsername, EventMessage,
        EventRiskScore, AbstractEventId, AbstractIdentity, AbstractSourceTable
};

","connectorBase":"union isfuzzy=true (AbstractEventLogs_CL | project TimeGenerated), (union isfuzzy=true ASimAuditEventLogs, ASimAuthenticationEventLogs, ASimDnsActivityLogs, ASimFileEventLogs, ASimNetworkSessionLogs, ASimProcessEventLogs, ASimRegistryEventLogs, ASimWebSessionLogs, ASimAlertEventLogs, ASimDhcpEventLogs, ASimUserManagementActivityLogs | where isnotnull(AdditionalFields.AbstractEventId) | project TimeGenerated), (OktaV2_CL | where set_has_element(dynamic(__ABSTRACT_NATIVE_VENDORS__), 'okta') | project TimeGenerated), (union isfuzzy=true CommonSecurityLog, Syslog | where CollectorHostName == 'Abstract' | project TimeGenerated), (AWSCloudTrail | where set_has_element(dynamic(__ABSTRACT_NATIVE_VENDORS__), 'aws-cloudtrail') | project TimeGenerated), (CrowdStrikeHostsV2_CL | where set_has_element(dynamic(__ABSTRACT_NATIVE_VENDORS__), 'crowdstrike-hosts') | project TimeGenerated)","connectorLast":"union isfuzzy=true (AbstractEventLogs_CL | project TimeGenerated), (union isfuzzy=true ASimAuditEventLogs, ASimAuthenticationEventLogs, ASimDnsActivityLogs, ASimFileEventLogs, ASimNetworkSessionLogs, ASimProcessEventLogs, ASimRegistryEventLogs, ASimWebSessionLogs, ASimAlertEventLogs, ASimDhcpEventLogs, ASimUserManagementActivityLogs | where isnotnull(AdditionalFields.AbstractEventId) | project TimeGenerated), (OktaV2_CL | where set_has_element(dynamic(__ABSTRACT_NATIVE_VENDORS__), 'okta') | project TimeGenerated), (union isfuzzy=true CommonSecurityLog, Syslog | where CollectorHostName == 'Abstract' | project TimeGenerated), (AWSCloudTrail | where set_has_element(dynamic(__ABSTRACT_NATIVE_VENDORS__), 'aws-cloudtrail') | project TimeGenerated), (CrowdStrikeHostsV2_CL | where set_has_element(dynamic(__ABSTRACT_NATIVE_VENDORS__), 'crowdstrike-hosts') | project TimeGenerated)
| summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
| where isnotempty(Time)","connectorConnected":"union isfuzzy=true (AbstractEventLogs_CL | project TimeGenerated), (union isfuzzy=true ASimAuditEventLogs, ASimAuthenticationEventLogs, ASimDnsActivityLogs, ASimFileEventLogs, ASimNetworkSessionLogs, ASimProcessEventLogs, ASimRegistryEventLogs, ASimWebSessionLogs, ASimAlertEventLogs, ASimDhcpEventLogs, ASimUserManagementActivityLogs | where isnotnull(AdditionalFields.AbstractEventId) | project TimeGenerated), (OktaV2_CL | where set_has_element(dynamic(__ABSTRACT_NATIVE_VENDORS__), 'okta') | project TimeGenerated), (union isfuzzy=true CommonSecurityLog, Syslog | where CollectorHostName == 'Abstract' | project TimeGenerated), (AWSCloudTrail | where set_has_element(dynamic(__ABSTRACT_NATIVE_VENDORS__), 'aws-cloudtrail') | project TimeGenerated), (CrowdStrikeHostsV2_CL | where set_has_element(dynamic(__ABSTRACT_NATIVE_VENDORS__), 'crowdstrike-hosts') | project TimeGenerated)
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| summarize LastLogReceived = max(TimeGenerated)
| project IsConnected = LastLogReceived > ago(3d)","ruleHighOrCritical":"// Abstract Security - High or Critical event.
// Reads the tables directly and calls no workspace function (Defender custom detections cannot call them).
// The Abstract table holds what no ASIM dataflow took (findings, alerts and unmapped events); the ASim
// tables hold the Abstract events the ASIM dataflows took, recognised by AdditionalFields.AbstractEventId.
// When the deployment stores a lane's events only in that lane's table (excludeNativeVendorsFromAsim), that table is read
// too: OktaV2_CL, and Abstract rows (CollectorHostName 'Abstract') in CommonSecurityLog and Syslog. Abstract findings on the
// asim-alert lane are read by the rule "Abstract Security - Finding", not here.
let lookback = 1h;
union isfuzzy=true
    (AbstractEventLogs_CL
        | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
        | extend AbstractSeverity = tolower(coalesce(severity, tostring(event.severity)))
        | where AbstractSeverity in ("high", "critical")
        | project TimeGenerated, AbstractSeverity, EventProduct = product, EventMessage = message,
            SrcIpAddr = coalesce(source_ipv4, source_ipv6, source_address), ActorUsername = coalesce(user_name, user_id),
            AbstractInsightId = acs_id, SourceTable = "AbstractEventLogs_CL"),
    (union isfuzzy=true ASimAuditEventLogs, ASimAuthenticationEventLogs, ASimDnsActivityLogs, ASimFileEventLogs,
        ASimNetworkSessionLogs, ASimProcessEventLogs, ASimRegistryEventLogs, ASimWebSessionLogs
        | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
        | where isnotnull(AdditionalFields.AbstractEventId) and EventSeverity == "High"
        | project TimeGenerated, AbstractSeverity = "high", EventProduct, EventMessage = column_ifexists("EventMessage", ""),
            SrcIpAddr = column_ifexists("SrcIpAddr", ""),
            ActorUsername = coalesce(column_ifexists("ActorUsername", ""), column_ifexists("TargetUsername", "")),
            AbstractInsightId = tostring(AdditionalFields.AbstractEventId), SourceTable = Type),
    (OktaV2_CL
        | where set_has_element(dynamic(__ABSTRACT_NATIVE_VENDORS__), 'okta')
        | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
        | where EventSeverity == "High"
        | project TimeGenerated, AbstractSeverity = "high", EventProduct = "Okta", EventMessage, SrcIpAddr, ActorUsername,
            AbstractInsightId = EventOriginalUid, SourceTable = "OktaV2_CL"),
    (CommonSecurityLog
        | where set_has_element(dynamic(__ABSTRACT_NATIVE_VENDORS__), 'csl-cef') or set_has_element(dynamic(__ABSTRACT_NATIVE_VENDORS__), 'csl-acs')
        | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
        | where CollectorHostName == "Abstract" and (toint(LogSeverity) >= 7 or LogSeverity in~ ("high", "very-high", "critical"))
        | project TimeGenerated, AbstractSeverity = "high", EventProduct = DeviceProduct, EventMessage = Activity, SrcIpAddr = SourceIP,
            ActorUsername = SourceUserName, AbstractInsightId = "", SourceTable = "CommonSecurityLog"),
    (Syslog
        | where set_has_element(dynamic(__ABSTRACT_NATIVE_VENDORS__), 'syslog')
        | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
        | where CollectorHostName == "Abstract" and SeverityLevel in ("crit", "alert", "emerg")
        | project TimeGenerated, AbstractSeverity = "high", EventProduct = ProcessName, EventMessage = SyslogMessage, SrcIpAddr = HostIP,
            ActorUsername = "", AbstractInsightId = "", SourceTable = "Syslog")
| project TimeGenerated, AbstractSeverity, EventProduct, EventMessage, SrcIpAddr, ActorUsername, AbstractInsightId, SourceTable
","ruleAuthFailures":"// Abstract - Repeated auth failures followed by success.
// Reads the tables directly and calls no workspace function (Defender custom detections cannot call them).
// Authentication events are in ASimAuthenticationEventLogs when the ASIM dataflows are on, and in the
// Abstract table otherwise (or in both, when the one-copy option is off); one row per Abstract event id.
// When the deployment stores a vendor's events only in that vendor's table (excludeNativeVendorsFromAsim), that table is read too.
let lookback = 1h;
let auth = union isfuzzy=true
    (AbstractEventLogs_CL
        | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
        | extend _category = tolower(tostring(event.category)), _outcome = tolower(tostring(event.outcome))
        | where _category has "authentication" or _category has "session" or tolower(action) has_any ("login", "logon", "auth")
        | project TimeGenerated, AbstractEventId = acs_id, SrcIpAddr = coalesce(source_ipv4, source_ipv6, source_address),
            ActorUsername = coalesce(user_name, user_id), EventProduct = product,
            EventResult = case(_outcome in ("success", "succeeded", "allowed", "allow"), "Success",
                               _outcome in ("failure", "failed", "fail", "denied", "blocked", "deny"), "Failure", "NA")),
    (ASimAuthenticationEventLogs
        | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
        | where isnotnull(AdditionalFields.AbstractEventId)
        | project TimeGenerated, AbstractEventId = tostring(AdditionalFields.AbstractEventId), SrcIpAddr,
            ActorUsername = TargetUsername, EventProduct, EventResult),
    (OktaV2_CL
        | where set_has_element(dynamic(__ABSTRACT_NATIVE_VENDORS__), 'okta')
        | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
        | where EventOriginalType has_any ("user.session.start", "user.authentication")
        | project TimeGenerated, AbstractEventId = EventOriginalUid, SrcIpAddr, ActorUsername, EventProduct = "Okta", EventResult)
    | extend _key = iff(isempty(AbstractEventId), strcat(tostring(TimeGenerated), SrcIpAddr, ActorUsername, EventResult), AbstractEventId)
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by _key;
let failures = auth
    | where EventResult == "Failure"
    | summarize Failures = count(), FailUsers = make_set(ActorUsername, 25) by SrcIpAddr, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
    | where Failures >= 10;
let successes = auth
    | where EventResult == "Success"
    | project SuccessTime = TimeGenerated, SrcIpAddr, ActorUsername, AbstractInsightId = AbstractEventId, EventProduct;
failures
| join kind=inner successes on SrcIpAddr
| where SuccessTime between (TimeGenerated .. (TimeGenerated + 10m))
| where set_has_element(FailUsers, ActorUsername)
| project SuccessTime, SrcIpAddr, ActorUsername, Failures, EventProduct, AbstractInsightId
| sort by Failures desc
","ruleFinding":"// Abstract Security - Finding.
// One alert per Abstract finding that the asim-alert lane wrote to ASimAlertEventLogs, Microsoft's ASIM Alert table.
// Reads the table directly and calls no workspace function (Defender custom detections cannot call them, and the
// built-in ASIM Alert parser did not yet read ASimAlertEventLogs when this was tested).
// With store-once and excludeNativeVendorsFromAsim on, findings are only in this table, so this rule is how they become
// incidents. Without them, findings are also in AbstractEventLogs_CL and "High or Critical event" sees the high ones:
// enable one of the two for findings, not both. The placeholder below keeps the rule's text in step with the deployment.
let lookback = 1h;
let deployedLanes = dynamic(__ABSTRACT_NATIVE_VENDORS__);
ASimAlertEventLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where isnotnull(AdditionalFields.AbstractEventId) and EventVendor == "Abstract Security"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by AbstractInsightId = tostring(AdditionalFields.AbstractEventId)

Runs inside Azure's deployment-script container as
# the user-assigned managed identity the template creates. It:
#   1. unpacks the kit bundle from KIT_BUNDLE_B64 after checking its SHA-256 (nothing is downloaded);
#   2. puts az-shim.ps1 on PATH as `az`, because this container has no Azure CLI and the kit reads through `az rest`;
#   3. waits until every role the template assigned is in effect (role assignments take minutes to apply), and fails
#      the deployment if they are not, rather than letting the kit record 403s and produce an inventory that looks complete;
#   4. runs Get-SentinelInventory.ps1 unchanged, with -SkipEntra (the identity cannot hold Entra Global Reader);
#   5. uploads the zip, every CSV, summary.json and this transcript to the customer's storage account.
# The only writes it makes are blobs in that storage account.
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'
$stamp = [datetime]::UtcNow.ToString('yyyyMMddTHHmmssZ')
$work = Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) "sentinel-discovery-$stamp"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $work -Force | Out-Null
$transcript = Join-Path $work 'inventory.log'
Start-Transcript -Path $transcript | Out-Null

$sub = $env:WS_SUBSCRIPTION_ID; $rg = $env:WS_RESOURCE_GROUP; $wsName = $env:WS_NAME
$prefix = "runs/$($wsName)/$stamp"
$wsPath = "/subscriptions/$sub/resourceGroups/$rg/providers/Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces/$wsName"
# The template passes the deployment cloud's endpoints: ARM_ENDPOINT ends in "/", which the token resource keeps and a path does not.
$armResource = $env:ARM_ENDPOINT
$arm = $armResource.TrimEnd('/')
Write-Output "Sentinel discovery: workspace $wsPath"
Write-Output "Output: https://$($env:STORAGE_ACCOUNT).blob.$($env:STORAGE_SUFFIX)/$($env:CONTAINER)/$prefix/"

function Get-PlainToken([string]$Resource) {
    $t = Get-AzAccessToken -ResourceUrl $Resource
    if ($t.Token -is [securestring]) { return [System.Net.NetworkCredential]::new('', $t.Token).Password }
    return [string]$t.Token
}

$ctx = Get-AzContext
$storage = New-AzStorageContext -StorageAccountName $env:STORAGE_ACCOUNT -UseConnectedAccount
function Send-Blob([string]$File, [string]$Name, [string]$Type = 'application/octet-stream') {
    Set-AzStorageBlobContent -File $File -Container $env:CONTAINER -Blob "$prefix/$Name" -Context $storage -Properties @{ ContentType = $Type } -Force | Out-Null
}

$uploaded = $false
try {
    # 1. unpack the kit
    $bundle = [Convert]::FromBase64String($env:KIT_BUNDLE_B64)
    $sha = [BitConverter]::ToString([Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::HashData($bundle)).Replace('-', '').ToLowerInvariant()
    if ($sha -ne $env:KIT_BUNDLE_SHA256) { throw "Kit bundle SHA-256 $sha does not match the template's $($env:KIT_BUNDLE_SHA256)." }
    $kitDir = Join-Path $work 'kit'
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $kitDir -Force | Out-Null
    [IO.File]::WriteAllBytes((Join-Path $work 'kit.tgz'), $bundle)
    tar -xzf (Join-Path $work 'kit.tgz') -C $kitDir
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Could not extract the kit bundle.' }
    chmod 0755 (Join-Path $kitDir 'az')
    Write-Output "Kit bundle verified (sha256 $sha)."

    # 2. az shim
    $env:PATH = "$kitDir$([IO.Path]::PathSeparator)$($env:PATH)"
    $env:SENTINV_SHIM_SUBSCRIPTION = $sub
    $env:SENTINV_SHIM_TENANT = $ctx.Tenant.Id
    $env:SENTINV_SHIM_CLIENT_ID = $ctx.Account.Id
    $env:SENTINV_TOKEN_ARM = Get-PlainToken $armResource
    $env:SENTINV_TOKEN_LA = Get-PlainToken 'https://api.loganalytics.io'

    # 3. wait for the role assignments
    $armH = @{ Authorization = "Bearer $($env:SENTINV_TOKEN_ARM)" }
    $laH = @{ Authorization = "Bearer $($env:SENTINV_TOKEN_LA)" }
    $deadline = [datetime]::UtcNow.AddMinutes([int]$env:RBAC_WAIT_MINUTES)
    $probeFile = Join-Path $work 'probe.txt'
    Set-Content -Path $probeFile -Value "role check $stamp"
    $round = 0; $clean = 0
    while ($true) {
        $round++
        $fail = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()
        $customerId = $null
        # Only 401/403 mean "not in effect yet". A 404 on the workspace is a wrong name; anything else (for example a workspace
        # without Sentinel) is left for the kit to record, so it cannot hold the deployment until the deadline.
        $denied = { param($c) $c -eq 401 -or $c -eq 403 }
        $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "$arm$($wsPath)?api-version=2025-07-01" -Headers $armH -SkipHttpErrorCheck
        if ($r.StatusCode -eq 404) { throw "Workspace not found: $wsPath" }
        if ($r.StatusCode -eq 200) { $customerId = ($r.Content | ConvertFrom-Json).properties.customerId } elseif (& $denied $r.StatusCode) { $fail.Add("workspace GET $($r.StatusCode) (Reader / Log Analytics Reader)") }
        $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "$arm$($wsPath)/providers/Microsoft.SecurityInsights/alertRules?api-version=2025-07-01-preview" -Headers $armH -SkipHttpErrorCheck
        if (& $denied $r.StatusCode) { $fail.Add("Sentinel alertRules $($r.StatusCode) (Microsoft Sentinel Reader)") }
        if ($customerId) {
            # Measured: right after assignment, some table queries get 403 while others succeed, and "print" needs no table at all.
            # So read real tables, several times a round. A table the workspace lacks answers 400, which is not a refusal.
            foreach ($q in @('Usage | take 1', 'Operation | take 1', 'Heartbeat | take 1', 'Usage | take 1', 'Operation | take 1', 'Heartbeat | take 1')) {
                $qb = @{ query = $q; timespan = 'P1D' } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
                $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Method POST -Uri "https://api.loganalytics.io/v1/workspaces/$customerId/query" -Headers $laH -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $qb -SkipHttpErrorCheck
                if (& $denied $r.StatusCode) { $fail.Add("Log Analytics query '$q' $($r.StatusCode) (Log Analytics Reader)"); break }
            }
        }
        $body = @{ subscriptions = @($sub); query = "resources | where id =~ '$wsPath' | project id" } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
        $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Method POST -Uri "$arm/providers/Microsoft.ResourceGraph/resources?api-version=2024-04-01" -Headers $armH -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $body -SkipHttpErrorCheck
        if ((& $denied $r.StatusCode) -or ($r.StatusCode -eq 200 -and (($r.Content | ConvertFrom-Json).count -lt 1))) { $fail.Add("Resource Graph $($r.StatusCode), workspace not visible (Reader on the subscription)") }
        try { Send-Blob $probeFile '.role-check.txt' 'text/plain' } catch { $fail.Add("storage write (Storage Blob Data Contributor): $($_.Exception.Message)") }
        if ($fail.Count -eq 0) {
            $clean++
            if ($clean -ge 3) {
                Remove-AzStorageBlob -Container $env:CONTAINER -Blob "$prefix/.role-check.txt" -Context $storage -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
                Write-Output "Roles in effect: $clean clean rounds in a row, after $round round(s)."; break
            }
            Start-Sleep -Seconds 30; continue
        }
        $clean = 0
        if ([datetime]::UtcNow -gt $deadline) { throw "Roles not in effect after $($env:RBAC_WAIT_MINUTES) minutes: $($fail -join '; '). Not running the kit, so no partial inventory is produced." }
        Write-Output ("Waiting for role assignments (check {0}): {1}" -f $round, ($fail -join '; '))
        Start-Sleep -Seconds 20
    }

    # 4. run the kit unchanged, in its own process (it exits on preflight failure). If any read was still refused, run it once more.
    $forbidden = 0
    foreach ($attempt in 1..2) {
        $out = Join-Path $work "sentinel-inventory-$($wsName)-$stamp-$attempt"
        $kitArgs = @('-NoProfile', '-File', (Join-Path $kitDir 'Get-SentinelInventory.ps1'), '-SubscriptionId', $sub, '-ResourceGroup', $rg, '-WorkspaceName', $wsName,
                     '-OutDir', $out, '-SkipEntra', '-Days', $env:DAYS, '-DeviceDays', $env:DEVICE_DAYS, '-ProfileTopTables', $env:PROFILE_TOP_TABLES)
        if ($env:SKIP_RULE_TEXT -eq 'true') { $kitArgs += '-SkipRuleQueryText' }
        if ($env:SKIP_CONTENT_TEXT -eq 'true') { $kitArgs += '-SkipContentQueryText' }
        $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'   # the kit reports through its own files; a stderr line must not end this script
        & pwsh @kitArgs 2>&1 | ForEach-Object { Write-Output "$_" }
        $code = $LASTEXITCODE
        $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
        if ($code -ne 0 -or -not (Test-Path "$out.zip")) { throw "The inventory kit exited with $code." }
        $forbidden = @(Import-Csv (Join-Path $out 'read_errors.csv') | Where-Object { $_.FailureClass -in @('403', 'auth') }).Count
        if ($forbidden -eq 0 -or $attempt -eq 2) { break }
        Write-Output "Run $attempt had $forbidden refused read(s). Waiting 3 minutes, then running the kit once more."
        Start-Sleep -Seconds 180
    }

    # 5. upload
    Send-Blob "$out.zip" 'inventory.zip' 'application/zip'
    foreach ($f in Get-ChildItem -Path $out -File) {
        $type = if ($f.Extension -eq '.json') { 'application/json' } else { 'text/csv' }
        $name = if ($f.Name -in @('summary.json', 'read_errors.csv')) { $f.Name } else { "csv/$($f.Name)" }
        Send-Blob $f.FullName $name $type
    }
    $summary = Get-Content (Join-Path $out 'summary.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
    $errs = @(Import-Csv (Join-Path $out 'read_errors.csv'))
    $areas = @($summary.areas.PSObject.Properties)
    $ok = @($areas | Where-Object { $_.Value.status -eq 'ok' }).Count
    if ($forbidden -gt 0) { Write-Warning "$forbidden read(s) were refused (403/auth) after the role check passed: see read_errors.csv." }
    Write-Output "Inventory done: $ok of $($areas.Count) areas read completely, $($errs.Count) read error(s), $forbidden refused."
    $DeploymentScriptOutputs = @{
        runPrefix = $prefix; storageAccount = $env:STORAGE_ACCOUNT; container = $env:CONTAINER
        areasOk = $ok; areasTotal = $areas.Count; readErrors = $errs.Count; readsRefused = $forbidden
        kitVersion = $summary.kitVersion; apiCalls = $summary.azCalls
    }
    $uploaded = $true
}
finally {
    Stop-Transcript | Out-Null
    try { Send-Blob $transcript 'inventory.log' 'text/plain' } catch { Write-Warning "Could not upload the transcript: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
    if (-not $uploaded) { Write-Output 'Inventory did not complete; see inventory.log in the storage account.' }
}
","$fxv#2":"","$fxv#3":"","$fxv#4":"#!/bin/bash
# Bootstrap for the report deployment script (kind AzureCLI, which has Python 3). Runs as the same managed identity:
#   1. unpacks the report bundle from REPORT_BUNDLE_B64 after checking its SHA-256 (nothing is downloaded);
#   2. downloads inventory.zip that the inventory script wrote to the customer's storage account;
#   3. builds report.html with build_html_report.py. Its only outbound call is the anonymous Azure Retail Prices API
#      (prices.azure.com), which receives the region name and nothing from the tenant;
#   4. uploads report.html, prices.json and this log next to the inventory;
#   5. only when SEND_TO_ABSTRACT is true: PUTs inventory.zip and report.html to the SAS URL Abstract gave you.
set -euo pipefail
W=$(mktemp -d)
LOG="$W/report.log"
exec > >(tee -a "$LOG") 2>&1
put_blob() { az storage blob upload --auth-mode login --only-show-errors --overwrite --account-name "$STORAGE_ACCOUNT" -c "$CONTAINER" -n "$RUN_PREFIX/$2" -f "$1" --content-type "$3" -o none; }
finish() { code=$?; put_blob "$LOG" report.log text/plain || echo "could not upload report.log"; exit $code; }
trap finish EXIT

echo "Report for $RUN_PREFIX in $STORAGE_ACCOUNT/$CONTAINER"
echo "$REPORT_BUNDLE_B64" | base64 -d > "$W/report.tgz"
SHA=$(sha256sum "$W/report.tgz" | cut -d' ' -f1)
[ "$SHA" = "$REPORT_BUNDLE_SHA256" ] || { echo "Report bundle SHA-256 $SHA does not match the template's $REPORT_BUNDLE_SHA256"; exit 1; }
# This container has no tar binary (measured).
mkdir -p "$W/report" && python3 -I -c 'import sys,tarfile; tarfile.open(sys.argv[1]).extractall(sys.argv[2], filter="data")' "$W/report.tgz" "$W/report"
echo "Report bundle verified (sha256 $SHA)."

az storage blob download --auth-mode login --only-show-errors --account-name "$STORAGE_ACCOUNT" -c "$CONTAINER" -n "$RUN_PREFIX/inventory.zip" -f "$W/inventory.zip" -o none
python3 -I "$W/report/build_html_report.py" "$W/inventory.zip" --out "$W/report.html" --prices-json "$W/prices.json" --logo "$W/report/abstract-logo-black.svg" | tee "$W/result.json"
put_blob "$W/report.html" report.html "text/html; charset=utf-8"
put_blob "$W/prices.json" prices.json application/json
echo "Uploaded report.html and prices.json."

SENT=false
if [ "${SEND_TO_ABSTRACT:-false}" = "true" ]; then
  [ -n "${ABSTRACT_SAS_URL:-}" ] || { echo "sendToAbstract is true but no SAS URL was given"; exit 1; }
  case "$ABSTRACT_SAS_URL" in https://*\?*) ;; *) echo "The Abstract SAS URL must be an https container URL with a SAS query string"; exit 1;; esac
  BASE="${ABSTRACT_SAS_URL%%\?*}"; QUERY="${ABSTRACT_SAS_URL#*\?}"
  HOST=$(echo "$BASE" | cut -d/ -f3)
  NAME="$(echo "$RUN_PREFIX" | tr '/' '_')"
  for f in inventory.zip report.html; do
    src="$W/$f"; [ "$f" = inventory.zip ] && src="$W/inventory.zip"
    curl -sS --fail --max-time 300 -X PUT -H "x-ms-blob-type: BlockBlob" -H "x-ms-version: 2021-08-06" --data-binary "@$src" "$BASE/${NAME}_$f?$QUERY" -o /dev/null
    echo "Sent $f to $HOST (SAS token not logged)."
  done
  SENT=true
fi

python3 -I - "$W/result.json" "$SENT" "$STORAGE_ACCOUNT" "$CONTAINER" "$RUN_PREFIX" "$STORAGE_SUFFIX" > "$AZ_SCRIPTS_OUTPUT_PATH" <<'EOF'
import json, sys
r = json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
acct, cont, pre, suffix = sys.argv[3], sys.argv[4], sys.argv[5], sys.argv[6]
print(json.dumps({'reportUrl': f'https://{acct}.blob.{suffix}/{cont}/{pre}/report.html', 'sentToAbstract': sys.argv[2] == 'true',
                  'pricesLive': r['prices_live'], 'region': r['region'], 'tables': r['tables'], 'billableGbPerDay': str(r['billable_gb_day']),
                  'listCostPerMonthNow': str(r['now_month'])}))  # ARM's string() refuses a float, so floats leave here as text
EOF
echo "Done."
